verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board provides stronger tinted stage grouping but loses finish through a large empty middle band, several cramped routing merges, and truncated node text.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: FAIL: The main pipeline is packed into the upper half while a very large empty horizontal band separates it from the bottom operations panel.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have adequate breathing room, but the transform-to-storage interface compresses several colored routes and the storage cluster is visibly tighter than the earlier stages.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Distinct blue, teal, purple, green, and orange-tinted regions clearly organize the five pipeline stages and the separate operations commentary.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Color is varied and largely semantic across stages and outcomes, with green success, red rejection, orange warning or exception, and consistent flow-family hues.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: FAIL: Although there are no crosshair glyphs, multiple arrows converge ambiguously near the transform/storage boundary, and the query-service/cache area reads like exposed routing plumbing.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Stage headers and major containers align cleanly, but uneven container widths, the dense right-hand cluster, and the detached bottom panel interrupt the otherwise left-to-right rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: FAIL: The orange dashed return route makes a long top-border detour, teal and orange runs crowd together between transform and storage, and several short opposing arrows are difficult to parse quickly.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness (7.5) ranks first, intent-classification-2 (7.0) second, and the board under grade (6.5) third.
